name: fix-2026-10-31
title: Fixes of 2026-10-31: the parabola's book form (#2640) and length-or-vector (PR #2605)

cases.title: A parabola with a decimal coefficient keeps y² = 2.5x (your T13)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The answer and the panel row read «y² = 2.5x».

cases.title: 5/3 prints as a stacked fraction
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The answer reads y² = then 5 over 3 (stacked) then x.

cases.title: A negative fraction keeps the form
cases.lookFor: The answer reads y² = −5 over 3, then x; the parabola opens left.

cases.title: The ellipse still clears its fractions (unchanged)
Your T66: a box row shows the length form
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». It builds; the row reads «|AA'|=3|BC|».
cases.before: The row read the vector wording.

cases.title: Your T64: neither reading holds, so it is read as lengths and refused
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Refused: «לא ניתן: «AB = 1AC» מתקיים רק אם הפירמידה SABCD שטוחה…», the same answer «|AB| = |AC|» gets. No question; nothing added.

cases.title: A rider ratio row shows the length form
cases.lookFor: D at ¾ of AB; the row reads «|AD| = 3|BD|».
cases.before: Built, but the row read as vectors.

cases.title: A midpoint statement row shows the length form
cases.before: Built, but the row read as vectors.

cases.title: An edge point placed by a length shows the length form
cases.lookFor: E on AA'; the row reads «|AE| = |AB|».
cases.before: Built, but the row read as vectors.

cases.title: Behaviour change: an impossible ratio on an edge is refused, not asked
cases.lookFor: Refused the way «|AE| = 2|AA'|» is; no question.

cases.title: REFUSAL: both readings fit and differ, so it still asks
A marked vector row is unchanged
cases.lookFor: Arrowheads on BE and EC; the row keeps the vector wording.
